 Telpa, P.S.- Chapra Town, District- Saran at Chapra

 Versus

======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Rakesh Kumar, Advocate.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Ashok Kumar Singh, App.
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Purnendu Singh
 Oral Order

Heard Mr. Rakesh Kumar, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and Mr. Ashok Kumar Singh, learned APP for the State.
2.
The petitioner seeks pre-arrest bail in connection with Chapra (Town) P.S. Case No. 237 of 2021 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 467, 468 and 471/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that the petitioner has taken certain objectionable photographs and video of the informant and thereafter he started blackmailing her and pressurized her to show her nude body on video call.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.34663 of 2022(5) dt.23-03-2023 4.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submitted that the informant and the petitioner were in love relationship and due to pressure of the society and the family she was compelled to file complaint making allegation that certain video has been made viral whereas no such video and photographs were ever taken by the petitioner.

He further submitted that the victim/informant in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. has admitted that the petitioner has only threatened that he will make the video and photograph viral whereas no such illegal action was taken by the petitioner and in such circumstances she desired to withdraw the case Suraj Kumar Rai @ Suraj Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179139204/
1 against the petitioner.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. It appears that after the amendment in the Code of Criminal Procedure, the informant is required to be noticed, however Registry has also not taken notice of the said fact and this bail application has been listed today defect free.
6. This Court finds it proper that notice should be issued to the informant.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner is directed to implead the informant as opposite party no.2 in course of the day.
7. Issue notice to the opposite party no.2 through both the processes, ordinary process as well as under registered cover with A/D for which requisites etc. must be filed within a period of one week.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.34663 of 2022(5) dt.23-03-2023 8.
No coercive step shall be taken against the petitioner till the next date of hearing.

9. List this case forthwith after service of notice.
(Purnendu Singh, J) mantreshwar/-
